title: acer caudatum subsp. multiserratum
intro: Acer caudatum subsp. multiserratum, commonly known as the Taiwanese maple or Taiwan maple, is a subspecies of deciduous tree in the family Sapindaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, including providing relief for various health issues, such as fever reduction, anti-inflammatory effects, and antimicrobial actions. The health benefits of Acer caudatum subsp. multiserratum are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-oxidative, anti-cancer, and anti-viral properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
